mapper.insert: insert into user_session(user_id, status, source_ip, user_agent, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) values(#{userId}, #{status}, #{sourceIp}, #{userAgent}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, status, source_ip, user_agent, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from user_session where id = #{id} limit 1
select id, user_id, status, source_ip, user_agent, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from user_session where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc limit 1
